area: Burrow Run, the Meerkat's Time AI and the Jewel Wasp
summary: Burrow Run (71) moved from the Meerkat to the Jewel Wasp (Yash, 2026-11-22: the Meerkat keeps one Time game, Warpline). The card and preview seat the wasp; the scene's AI approach went from the Meerkat's searched genes (42/702/74) back to Warpline's (160/180/120); the controller no longer lays the Meerkat's omnicrystals or carries its nose row. No vessel file changed.
why: The Meerkat Time step 3 sign-off in loop.json cites the Burrow Run AI and was left as it is; the wasp's Time burst has nothing to ride in the barren race cell, and an AI wasp cannot ride for a ring without a change on the wasp (BURROWRUN.md section 2).
